title: द्विनवत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 192 · The Kauravas learn the Pandavas are alive

summary.en: Spies bring the news that the Pandavas live and have married Draupadi with Drupada as their ally. Duryodhana returns humiliated; Vidura tells Dhritarashtra, who feigns delight, and Duryodhana and Karna then press him to act against the Pandavas before they grow strong.
summary.kn: ಪಾಂಡವರು ಬದುಕಿದ್ದಾರೆ, ದ್ರುಪದನನ್ನು ಮಿತ್ರನಾಗಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು ದ್ರೌಪದಿಯನ್ನು ಮದುವೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆಂದು ಗೂಢಚಾರರು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅವಮಾನಿತ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನು ಮರಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ವಿದುರನು ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸಿದಾಗ ಅವನು ಸಂತೋಷ ನಟಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಪಾಂಡವರು ಬಲಿಷ್ಠರಾಗುವ ಮೊದಲೇ ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಲು ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಕರ್ಣರು ಒತ್ತಾಯಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: गुप्तचर समाचार लाते हैं कि पाण्डव जीवित हैं और द्रुपद को सहयोगी बनाकर द्रौपदी से विवाह कर चुके हैं। अपमानित दुर्योधन लौटता है; विदुर धृतराष्ट्र को बताते हैं, जो प्रसन्नता का दिखावा करते हैं, और दुर्योधन तथा कर्ण उनसे पाण्डवों के प्रबल होने से पहले कुछ करने का आग्रह करते हैं।
summary.te: పాండవులు బ్రతికే ఉన్నారని, ద్రుపదుని మిత్రునిగా చేసుకొని ద్రౌపదిని వివాహమాడారని గూఢచారులు చెబుతారు. అవమానితుడైన దుర్యోధనుడు తిరిగివస్తాడు; విదురుడు ధృతరాష్ట్రునికి చెప్పగా అతడు సంతోషం నటిస్తాడు; పాండవులు బలపడకముందే చర్య తీసుకోమని దుర్యోధన కర్ణులు ఒత్తిడి చేస్తారు.
summary.ta: பாண்டவர்கள் உயிருடன் இருக்கிறார்கள், த்ருபதனைக் கூட்டாளியாக்கித் திரௌபதியை மணந்துள்ளார்கள் என்று ஒற்றர்கள் செய்தி கொண்டு வருகிறார்கள். அவமானமுற்ற துரியோதனன் திரும்புகிறான்; விதுரர் திருதராஷ்டிரனிடம் சொல்ல அவன் மகிழ்ச்சி நடிக்கிறான்; பாண்டவர்கள் வலுப்பெறுவதற்குள் செயல்படுமாறு துரியோதனனும் கர்ணனும் வற்புறுத்துகிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: പാണ്ഡവർ ജീവനോടെയുണ്ടെന്നും, ദ്രുപദന്റെ സഖ്യത്തിൽ ദ്രൗപദിയെ വിവാഹം കഴിച്ചുവെന്നും ചാരന്മാർ വാർത്ത കൊണ്ടുവരുന്നു. അപമാനിതനായി മടങ്ങുന്ന ദുര്യോധനൻ; വിദുരർ അത് ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രരെ അറിയിക്കുന്നു, അദ്ദേഹം സന്തോഷം നടിക്കുന്നു; പാണ്ഡവർ ശക്തരാകുന്നതിന് മുൻപ് അവർക്കെതിരെ നടപടിയെടുക്കാൻ ദുര്യോധനനും കർണ്ണനും അദ്ദേഹത്തെ നിർബന്ധിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.192; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततो राज्ञां चरैराप्तैश्चारः समुपनीयत ।
पाण्डवैरुपसंपन्ना द्रौपदी पतिभिः शुभा ॥

meaning.en: Then the kings' trusted spies brought them the news: the fair Draupadi had been won by the Pandavas and had them as her husbands.

verses.text:
येन तद्धनुरायम्य लक्ष्यं विद्धं महात्मना ।
सोऽर्जुनो जयतां श्रेष्ठो महाबाणधनुर्धरः ॥

meaning.en: The one who bent that bow and struck the target, the great-souled Arjuna, best of conquerors and bearer of the great bow and arrows,

verses.text:
यः शल्यं मद्रराजानमुत्क्षिप्याभ्रामयद्बली ।
त्रासयंश्चापि संक्रुद्धो वृक्षेण पुरुषान्रणे ॥

meaning.en: and the mighty one who lifted Shalya, king of the Madras, and whirled him, and in anger terrified men in battle with a tree, was Bhima,

verses.text:
न चापि संभ्रमः कश्चिदासीत्तत्र महात्मनः ।
स भीमो भीमसंस्पर्शः शत्रुसेनाङ्गपातनः ॥

meaning.en: who showed no confusion at all there, Bhima of terrible touch, who felled the bodies of enemy armies.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मरूपधराञ्श्रुत्वा पाण्डुराजसुतांस्तदा ।
कौन्तेयान्मनुजेन्द्राणां विस्मयः समजायत ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that the sons of King Pandu, sons of Kunti, had been in Brahmin disguise, the kings were amazed.

verses.text:
सपुत्रा हि पुरा कुन्ती दग्धा जतुगृहे श्रुता ।
पुनर्जातानिति स्मैतान्मन्यन्ते सर्वपार्थिवाः ॥

meaning.en: For it had been heard that Kunti with her sons had been burnt in the house of lac, and now all the kings thought of them as born again.

verses.text:
धिक्कुर्वन्तस्तदा भीष्मं धृतराष्ट्रं च कौरवम् ।
कर्मणा सुनृशंसेन पुरोचनकृतेन वै ॥

meaning.en: They then cursed Bhishma and the Kaurava Dhritarashtra for the very cruel deed done by Purochana.

verses.text:
वृत्ते स्वयंवरे चैव राजानः सर्व एव ते ।
यथागतं विप्रजग्मुर्विदित्वा पाण्डवान्वृतान् ॥

meaning.en: When the svayamvara was over, all those kings, learning that the Pandavas had been chosen, went back as they had come.

verses.text:
अथ दुर्योधनो राजा विमना भ्रातृभिः सह ।
अश्वत्थाम्ना मातुलेन कर्णेन च कृपेण च ॥

meaning.en: Then King Duryodhana, downcast, with his brothers, Ashvatthama, his maternal uncle Shakuni, Karna and Kripa,

verses.text:
विनिवृत्तो वृतं दृष्ट्वा द्रौपद्या श्वेतवाहनम् ।
तं तु दुःशासनो व्रीडन्मन्दं मन्दमिवाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: turned back, having seen that Draupadi had chosen the white-horsed Arjuna. Dushasana, ashamed, spoke to him quietly, as it were:

verses.text:
यद्यसौ ब्राह्मणो न स्याद्विन्देत द्रौपदीं न सः ।
न हि तं तत्त्वतो राजन्वेद कश्चिद्धनंजयम् ॥

meaning.en: If he were not a Brahmin, he would not have won Draupadi; for, king, no one knew him truly as Dhananjaya.

verses.text:
दैवं तु परमं मन्ये पौरुषं तु निरर्थकम् ।
धिगस्मत्पौरुषं तात यद्धरन्तीह पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: I think destiny is supreme and human effort useless. Shame on our manliness, brother, that the Pandavas are alive here.

verses.text:
एवं संभाषमाणास्ते निन्दन्तश्च पुरोचनम् ।
विविशुर्हास्तिनपुरं दीना विगतचेतसः ॥

meaning.en: Speaking thus and blaming Purochana, they entered Hastinapura, dejected and bereft of their wits.

verses.text:
त्रस्ता विगतसंकल्पा दृष्ट्वा पार्थान्महौजसः ।
मुक्तान्हव्यवहाच्चैनान्संयुक्तान्द्रुपदेन च ॥

meaning.en: Frightened and with their plans shattered at seeing the mighty sons of Pritha freed from the fire and allied with Drupada,

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नं च संचिन्त्य तथैव च शिखण्डिनम् ।
द्रुपदस्यात्मजांश्चान्यान्सर्वयुद्धविशारदान् ॥

meaning.en: and thinking of Dhrishtadyumna, Shikhandin and Drupada's other sons, all skilled in war,

verses.text:
विदुरस्त्वथ ताञ्श्रुत्वा द्रौपद्या पाण्डवान्वृतान् ।
व्रीडितान्धार्तराष्ट्रांश्च भग्नदर्पानुपागतान् ॥

meaning.en: Vidura heard that Draupadi had chosen the Pandavas and that the sons of Dhritarashtra had returned ashamed, their pride broken.

verses.text:
ततः प्रीतमनाः क्षत्ता धृतराष्ट्रं विशां पते ।
उवाच दिष्ट्या कुरवो वर्धन्त इति विस्मितः ॥

meaning.en: Then the delighted Kshatta said to Dhritarashtra, lord of the people, amazed: By good fortune the Kurus are prospering.

verses.text:
वैचित्रवीर्यस्तु नृपो निशम्य विदुरस्य तत् ।
अब्रवीत्परमप्रीतो दिष्ट्या दिष्ट्येति भारत ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that from Vidura, King Dhritarashtra, son of Vichitravirya, said with great joy, 'Good fortune, good fortune,' Bharata.

verses.text:
मन्यते हि वृतं पुत्रं ज्येष्ठं द्रुपदकन्यया ।
दुर्योधनमविज्ञानात्प्रज्ञाचक्षुर्नरेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: For the king with the eye of wisdom, in ignorance, thought that his eldest son Duryodhana had been chosen by Drupada's daughter.

verses.text:
अथ त्वाज्ञापयामास द्रौपद्या भूषणं बहु ।
आनीयतां वै कृष्णेति पुत्रं दुर्योधनं तदा ॥

meaning.en: Then he ordered that many ornaments be brought for Draupadi, saying, 'Let Krishna be brought' along with his son Duryodhana.

verses.text:
अथास्य पश्चाद्विदुर आचख्यौ पाण्डवान्वृतान् ।
सर्वान्कुशलिनो वीरान्पूजितान्द्रुपदेन च ।
तेषां संबन्धिनश्चान्यान्बहून्बलसमन्वितान् ॥

meaning.en: Then Vidura told him that the Pandavas had been chosen, that all those heroes were well and had been honoured by Drupada, and that they had many other mighty relatives by marriage.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
यथैव पाण्डोः पुत्रास्ते तथैवाभ्यधिका मम ।
सेयमभ्यधिका प्रीतिर्वृद्धिर्विदुर मे मता ।
यत्ते कुशलिनो वीरा मित्रवन्तश्च पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: The sons of Pandu are as dear to me as my own, indeed dearer. Vidura, I count this as great joy and growth, that the Pandava heroes are well and have friends.

verses.text:
को हि द्रुपदमासाद्य मित्रं क्षत्तः सबान्धवम् ।
न बुभूषेद्भवेनार्थी गतश्रीरपि पार्थिवः ॥

meaning.en: Kshatta, what king, even one who has lost his fortune, would not wish to have Drupada and his kin as an ally, if he wants prosperity?

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
तं तथा भाषमाणं तु विदुरः प्रत्यभाषत ।
नित्यं भवतु ते बुद्धिरेषा राजञ्शतं समाः ॥

meaning.en: To him speaking so, Vidura replied: King, may this thought of yours remain for a hundred years.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनश्चैव राधेयश्च विशां पते ।
धृतराष्ट्रमुपागम्य वचोऽब्रूतामिदं तदा ॥

meaning.en: Then Duryodhana and Radha's son Karna, lord of the people, went to Dhritarashtra and spoke these words.

verses.text:
संनिधौ विदुरस्य त्वां वक्तुं नृप न शक्नुवः ।
विविक्तमिति वक्ष्यावः किं तवेदं चिकीर्षितम् ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana and Karna said: King, we could not speak to you in Vidura's presence. We will speak in private: what is this that you intend?

verses.text:
सपत्नवृद्धिं यत्तात मन्यसे वृद्धिमात्मनः ।
अभिष्टौषि च यत्क्षत्तुः समीपे द्विपदां वर ॥

meaning.en: Father, you think the enemy's growth is your own growth, and you praise them in front of Kshatta, best of men.

verses.text:
अन्यस्मिन्नृप कर्तव्ये त्वमन्यत्कुरुषेऽनघ ।
तेषां बलविघातो हि कर्तव्यस्तात नित्यशः ॥

meaning.en: Sinless king, when one thing is to be done you are doing another. Father, we must always break their strength.

verses.text:
ते वयं प्राप्तकालस्य चिकीर्षां मन्त्रयामहे ।
यथा नो न ग्रसेयुस्ते सपुत्रबलबान्धवान् ॥

meaning.en: So we are consulting about what to do at the proper time, so that they do not devour us, with our sons, armies and kinsmen.
